story.setup: A solitary rider enters a high forest trail.
story.escalation: The rider accelerates through trees and over rocky singletrack.
story.turn: The forest opens onto exposed ground with airborne moments.
story.resolution: The trail returns to forest, then the camera rises to leave the rider in the landscape.

visual.style: Original rendered 3D realism study; physically connected rider and bike; textured mountain terrain; atmospheric perspective
visual.lighting: Single warm directional key, cool fill, distance haze
depth_rules: Foreground stones, moving rider, forest and mountain backgrounds
typography_rules: One opening title and short ending credit; no debug overlays
texture_rules: CC0 Poly Haven ground materials; authored geometry

effects: locally synthesized tire gravel and jump landing pulses
silence_rules: Short end fade only; no false silence promise
sync_rules: Jump sound events derive from the same world route and time function as picture

known_limits: Software rasterization on Pixel; this is visibly computer-rendered and not photorealistic.
Audible and continuous audiovisual perception unavailable in this session; do not mark perceptual PASS.

intent.visible_event: The same orange-jacketed rider advances along a connected mountain singletrack, viewed in aerial.
viewer_reads: The same orange-jacketed rider advances along a connected mountain singletrack, viewed in aerial.

motion.subject: Wheels rotate from traveled distance; early pedaling becomes technical coasting; bent limbs stay attached to controls; lean follows route curvature.
motion.environment: World-fixed trees and rocks create depth-dependent parallax.

look.palette: ochre dirt, forest green, blue haze

audio.cue: Continuous rock score and tire/air bed; landing accents from shared jump times.

continuity_dependencies: Same rider, bicycle, continuous increasing route distance
